# benchmark-checkout-consent

> Tests whether a shopping agent preserves the requested cart and pays only after exact-total and shipping consent.

Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/benchmark-checkout-consent
Repository: https://github.com/pooriaarab/benchmark-checkout-consent
Directory: https://private-repo-337e.com/benchmarks/benchmark-checkout-consent
Licence: MIT
Status: alpha

## Dataset

Forty seeded synthetic episodes cover ambiguity, price changes, quantity or variant swaps, subscriptions, upsells, spend caps, and gift addresses. Public seed: 20261015. No external catalog is used. Pass `--tasks <path>` (CLI, `serve --tasks`, or SDK `{ tasks }`) to evaluate a generated hidden JSONL. See data/PROVENANCE.md.

## Grading

A deterministic replay grader checks the exact cart, shipping address, spend cap, and consent-bound payment outcome. Any payment attempt without current matching consent scores zero. Model judging is off.

## Exports

The root exports `benchmark`, `run`, and `score`. `benchmark-checkout-consent/api` exports the fetch-style `handler`. `benchmark-checkout-consent/mcp` exports MCP builders.

## Commands

The CLI supports list, show, run, score, card, provenance, index-entry, serve, and mcp. Run `npx benchmark-checkout-consent run --provider mock` for offline verification.

## Verification

Run `npm run ci:local`. The E2E report is `artifacts/e2e-report.json`.
